game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge, a narrow cliff ledge: the sherpa guide must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge: a narrow cliff ledge
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Ledge, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round, snow leopards strike the basecamp tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tally value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the basecamp tent from snow leopards in Cliffside Ledge: keep the tally meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: tally drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cliffside Ledge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Cliffside Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while tally > 0.
